page: Microsoft Azure DC16es_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCEV6 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage options, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated GPUs, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and memory-to-core ratio position this instance for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of local storage. Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe drives and hardware accelerators. It is designed for memory-optimized workloads, database nodes, and general-purpose enterprise applications that utilize network-attached storage.
